MOLECULAR PATHOLOGY REPORT
[redacted location] Cancer Center
Department of Pathology and Laboratory Medicine

Patient: [redacted name]
MRN: [redacted ID]
DOB: [redacted date]
Sex: Female
Specimen ID: [redacted ID]
Ordering Physician: Dr. [redacted name]
Date Collected: [redacted date]
Date Received: [redacted date]
Date Reported: [redacted date]

CLINICAL HISTORY
Elderly female patient with poorly differentiated carcinoma with skin infiltration from chest wall abscess biopsy. Suspected lung cancer requiring evaluation for targeted therapy options.

SPECIMEN
Chest wall abscess biopsy, formalin-fixed paraffin-embedded tissue
Tumor content: >50% (confirmed by H&E review)

TESTS PERFORMED
1. Fluorescence In Situ Hybridization (FISH) Analysis
   - ALK gene rearrangement
   - ROS1 gene rearrangement
2. Next-Generation Sequencing
   - GeneQuick Pathway Panel with GenomScan sequencing platform
   - Genes analyzed: EGFR, KRAS, NRAS, BRAF

SUMMARY OF RESULTS
No actionable alterations detected. The tumor is negative for ALK and ROS1 rearrangements by FISH. Molecular analysis reveals wild-type status for EGFR, KRAS, NRAS, and BRAF genes. Based on these findings, the patient is unlikely to benefit from EGFR, ALK, or ROS1 tyrosine kinase inhibitors.

DETAILED RESULTS

FLUORESCENCE IN SITU HYBRIDIZATION (FISH)

ALK Gene Rearrangement Analysis
Probe: Vysis ALK Break Apart FISH Probe Kit
Cells analyzed: 50
Result: NEGATIVE for ALK rearrangement
Pattern: 2-3 fusion signals per cell
Interpretation: No evidence of ALK gene rearrangement

ROS1 Gene Rearrangement Analysis
Probe: Vysis ROS1 Break Apart FISH Probe Kit
Cells analyzed: 50
Result: NEGATIVE for ROS1 rearrangement
Pattern: Normal signal pattern observed
Interpretation: No evidence of ROS1 gene rearrangement

MOLECULAR ANALYSIS - GeneQuick Pathway Panel

Methodology: Targeted next-generation sequencing using GenomScan sequencing platform
Coverage: Minimum 500x depth
Variant allele frequency detection limit: 5%

Gene Analysis Results:

EGFR (NM_005228.5)
Exons analyzed: 18-21
Result: Wild type
No pathogenic variants detected

KRAS (NM_033360.4)
Codons analyzed: 12, 13, 59, 61, 117, 146
Result: Wild type
No pathogenic variants detected

NRAS (NM_002524.5)
Codons analyzed: 12, 13, 59, 61, 146
Result: Wild type
No pathogenic variants detected

BRAF (NM_004333.6)
Codons analyzed: 600, 601
Result: Wild type
No pathogenic variants detected

QUALITY METRICS
DNA concentration: 45 ng/μL
DNA quality (DIN): 3.2
Mean coverage depth: 1,250x
Uniformity: 98%
On-target rate: 99.2%

INTERPRETATION
Comprehensive molecular profiling reveals no targetable alterations in this poorly differentiated carcinoma. The absence of ALK and ROS1 rearrangements, combined with wild-type status for EGFR, KRAS, NRAS, and BRAF, indicates that this tumor lacks the common driver mutations associated with response to currently approved targeted therapies for lung adenocarcinoma.

No variants with established therapeutic or prognostic implications were detected in the analyzed genes.

RECOMMENDATIONS
Based on these negative findings, no specific targeted therapies are indicated. Standard chemotherapy regimens should be considered. Immunotherapy eligibility assessment including PD-L1 expression testing may be warranted.

This report has been reviewed and electronically signed by:
[redacted name], MD, PhD
Board Certified in Molecular Genetic Pathology
[redacted date]
